title: Kenworth T909 heavy duty custom built FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar #104
description: Kenworth T909 Custom Built high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar. 78mm diameter one piece main cross pipes passing through drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds, 80mm & 100mm diameter pipe available as option. Hi-tensile box uprights, custom designed deep heavy duty main channel with wombat flap & provision for front mudflaps. Flip over Road Train signs and KW logo engraved in end plates. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with 35mm tow pin covered by a hinged number plate mount. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Helper spring fitted to assist with raising and lowering Bullbar. 50mm flat bar extension added to the top of the main channel. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
